Commentary.Commentary: Surprisingly, Iqbal came out to bat with an injury and was an inspiration to many. The last-wicket stand of 32 from 16 between him and Mushfiqur could prove to be the difference. For Sri Lanka, Lasith Malinga was the pick of the bowlers and finished with figures of 10-2-23-4. Dhananjaya de Silva also bowled well to take 2 wickets. So, it is a pretty competitive total on this surface where the ball is holding up on occasions. Can Sri Lanka keep their calm and chase this down? Or will Bangladesh capitalize on the momentum? Join us on the other side of the break.

A rearguard effort from Mohammad Mithun and Mushfiqur Rahim got their side back on track. They stitched a 131-run stand and mixed caution with aggression to perfection. Once the former departed, Bangladesh lost a couple of quick wickets but Rahim went strong from the other end. He was dropped twice, on 10 and 85, and made the most of it. He got good support from the lower order, crossed his hundred and helped to stabilize his team.

An outstanding knock from Mushfiqur Rahim has ensured that Bangladesh coast past the 250-run mark. It didn't look likely at all but the wicket-keeper batsman was in the thick of things. It was a terrible start for the Bangla Tigers though as they lost two wickets for just 1 run on the board. To add salt to the wound, Tamim Iqbal got retired hurt just after that as he took a blow on his left wrist. It seemed like Lasith Malinga would run through the middle order but it wasn't to be.

OUT! Rahim departs but not before playing what could be a game-changing knock! Full ball around off, Rahim heaves it towards long on. Kusal Mendis runs in from the deep and dives full length to take a terrific catch. BANGLADESH ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 261!
SIX! Back-to-back biggies! What a hit. Length ball on middle, Rahim picks it up and swipes it over deep square leg to send it into the stands.
SIX! He is flowing like a river at the moment! Overpitched outside off, Rahim lines it up and lifts it over extra cover for a maximum.
Thisara Perera to bowl the last over.
Rahim takes the run and the crowd applauds for him. Taps this one towards covers and goes to the other end to retain strike.
Bouncer this time, pulled away towards deep square leg. Rahim doesn't take the single.
On a back of a length around off, Rahim makes room to hit it through covers but gets a bottom edge down the track.
Short ball on middle, pulled from the toe end of the bat to the leg side.
On middle and leg, tapped down towards square leg.
FOUR! Drilled! Overpitched on off, Rahim hits it over extra cover for a rocketing boundary.
Dasun Shanaka to have a bowl now.
Length ball outside off, placed past point for a run. 15 from the over.
SIX! Picked the bones out of that one! Clean as a whistle. Short ball on middle and leg, Rahim pulls it with aplomb over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.

FOUR! Cheeky! Full ball on off, Rahim who premeditated to play the paddle scoop has to adjust. Scoops it over short third man instead to find the fence. This is now Rahim's highest score in ODIs, going past his previous best of 117.
Fractionally overpitched, lofted over wide mid on. He doesn't take the single.
FOUR! Brilliant! Even Rahim is cramping but he is on song with the bat. Full ball on off, drilled over mid off to beat the man in the deep.
Full ball outside off, driven hard to extra cover.

I haven't seen anything like this in cricket! Short of a length ball on middle, Iqbal holds the bat with one hand and defends it. He is protecting his bottom hand which is the injured hand. Fighting for the cause of his country.
Surprise, surprise! Tamim Iqbal comes out to bat. He  will bat with an injured wrist.

OUT! Good piece of fielding! Full ball on middle, Rahman defends it down the track and sets off. Rahim sends him back but he is already halfway down. Tries to get back to his crease as Mendis runs in from mid-wicket, picks up the ball and throws it back to the keeper who does the rest. It is referred upstairs. Mustafizur is miles out of his ground.

FOUR! Lazy effort in the deep from Thisara! Full ball, Rahman hits it off the toe end over mid-wicket. Perera runs across from wide long on and jogs across. Doesn't put in a slide and the ball meets the fence.
Overpitched delivery, drilled down to long on to change strike.
Full delivery, moving away. Rahman squeezes it out to covers and gives the strike back to Rahim.

Rahim skips down the track and Lakmal bowls a full toss in line of the stumps. Rahim manages to hit it towards extra cover and crosses over. He is asking the umpire for a waist high no ball. He had used his feet so it wasn't an illegal delivery and it was just below the waist.
Fullish ball on middle and leg, Rahim calmly dabs it towards mid-wicket for a single. Good for Bangladesh.
Length ball just outside off, Mushfiqur tries to run it down late but misses.
Slower in pace and on a fuller length on the pads, played with soft hands towards square leg to rotate strike.

A very full ball on middle, Rahim clears his front leg and whips it down to long on for a run. As he crossed to the other end, he was limping. Understandable as he has been batting since a long time. Might have pulled a muscle. It might hamper his keeping in the second half.
Another full ball attacking the stumps, clipped towards short mid-wicket.
Full ball, tailing in, Mushfiqur clears his front leg and defends it down the track.
A good shot from the No. 11! Slower through the air, Rahman makes room and goes inside out over extra cover. A couple taken.
Tossed up ball, eased through covers for a run.
Slower through the air, swept straight towards the man at 45.
Full ball on middle and leg, Mustafizur drags his heave to deep mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Innovation at its best! Tossed up ball, Rahim kneels and reverse sweeps it over short third man for a boundary. He is going strong.
Outside off, left alone.
On a length outside off, Rahman goes for a heave but misses.
On middle and leg, tucked to the leg side for a single.

FOUR! 6th ODI ton for Rahim and his 1st against Sri Lanka! He was dropped on two occasions, on 10 and on 85 and has made the most of the lives. Full and going down the leg side, Rahim tickles it past the keeper to the fine leg fence. He raises his bat towards the crowd and gets a well-deserved applause. Well played, Mushfiqur.
On a length outside off, played with an angled bat past point for a single.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single. Strange that Rahim has taken the run on the first ball again.
Suranga Lakmal returns.
Tossed up ball, kept out watchfully.

Not out! Sri Lanka lose their review! Coming in with the arm, Rahman tries to defend it but misses to get pinged on the pads. De Silva appeals long and hard but the umpire shakes his head. Mathews challenges the decision after some thought. Well, replay shows that the ball is missing the leg stump.
Is that the end of Bangladesh's innings? Rahman is the man in question regarding an LBW shout. Seems to be going down the leg side.
Mustafizur Rahman is the last man in.

OUT! Yes, it has pitched in line and the decision has been overturned! Coming in with the arm from around the wicket, Hossain leans ahead to block it but misses to get hit on the pads. The Sri Lankans go up in unison but the umpire stays put. Mathews takes the review quite soon. Time for the replays. The Hawk Eye rolls in and shows three reds. Rahim has an anxious look on his face. It will be difficult for him to get to his ton now it seems.
An LBW appeal against Rubel Hossain has been taken upstairs. Seems really close. The question is has it pitched in line.
Fullish ball on middle, pushed down the track back to the bowler.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Hossain taps it towards mid on.
Tossed up on middle, Rahim drives it down to long on for a single. Moves to 96. Not a good tactic though to take the run on the first ball and exposing the tailender.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
So close! Yorker on middle, Hossain tries to jam it out but the ball takes the bottom half of his bat and just goes over the stumps.
Full ball, down the leg side, Rubel tries to flick it but is hit on the pads.

Not out! There was clear bat on it! Don't know what on earth Hossain was thinking. It is Rahim who has saved him and his side for now. Full and fast ball, tailing in. Rubel tries to keep it out but seems to have got an inside edge onto his pads. Malinga appeals confidently and the umpire obliges. The tailender is seen walking off but Mushfiqur calls him back. He is furious with him. The 'T' has been signaled. The replay rolls in and shows the involvement of the willow. Sanity prevails eventually.

Review time! Hossain has been trapped in front of the stumps. He was walking off initially but Rahim called him back. They finally take the review. Looked like there was an inside edge to the naked eye. Let's find out....
Almost foxed Hossain! Full toss on middle and leg that dips on the batsman. He somehow keeps it out.
Malinga runs in with intent and attacks the stumps with a full ball. Hossain defends it in the nick of time.
A full toss on middle and off, Rahim shuffles a bit and taps it towards wide mid on.
Slower through the air around off, Rubel gets low and hits it down to long off for a single.
Tossed up delivery on leg stump, turned away with ease through square leg for an easy run.
Full ball at a quicker pace outside off, squeezed out to the man at covers.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Low full toss on middle and off, Rahim goes for the paddle sweep but doesn't find the gap. Thankfully for him, the ball goes on the bounce to the man at 45.
Time for Powerplay 3! Maximum of five fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
A slower ball from Malinga outside off, Rahim taps it past the point fielder and takes a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Overpitched on the boots, jammed out towards mid-wicket.
Another full ball tailing in, trying to bring the two short mid-wickets into play. Rubel leans ahead and clips it through square leg for a single.
Almost, almost! The fiercest weapon of Malinga on display. Bowls a yorker but is just outside the off stump line. Hossain is late to bring his bat down and gets beaten.
Full and fast ball on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Rubel Hossain strides out to bat. Meanwhile, Lasith Malinga is back on. Mathews is going for the kill.

OUT! One shot too many from Mortaza and he's out of here! Chose the wrong angle to go against. A bit quicker in pace from around the wicket, sliding across Mortaza. He tries to slog it across the line but the ball takes the outer half of the bat and lobs towards the point region. Tharanga won't drop those. A successful over for de Silva.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Slower through the air, defended solidly off the front foot.
Wide! Fires this one but loses control as the ball spins down the leg side. Mortaza fails to put it away but will get an extra run.
Continues to bowl it on the pads and Mushfiqur accumulates another easy run by flicking it through mid-wicket for a single. He moves onto 90 now.
Very full ball on the boots, Rahim clears his front leg and places it through the same region for a couple.
Fractionally overpitched on middle and leg, helped through backward square leg for a quick single.
Another one that is full and on the pads, easy pickings for Mortaza as he clips it through square leg for a run and will retain strike.
Another short ball, slower in pace this time and it is around off, Mashrafe sits beneath it.
FOUR! Played with authority! Short ball in line of the stumps, sits up nicely for Mortaza. He stands tall and pulls it through mid-wicket for a rocketing boundary.
A bouncer on middle and off, Mortaza ducks under it and evades it.
Straying on the pads, helped around the corner for a run.
Beaten! On a length outside off, Rahim pushes at it but misses.
Spinning towards the pads, helped to the leg side for a single.
Slower through the air, kept out watchfully.

DROPPED! Another sitter has been put down! Straight in and straight out. Tossed up ball on middle, Rahim drives it back towards de Silva. He lines it up and gets his two hands to it but the ball pops out. He can't believe it and has a blank expression on his face. Rahim was dropped on 10 by Dilruwan Perera and that was a straightforward catch as well.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Rahim uses his feet again and de Silva fires it in the blockhole. Squeezed off the outer half towards backward point.
A full toss outside off, Rahim goes for a booming drive but gets beaten. He missed out there.
Dhananjaya de Silva to roll his arm over again.
FOUR! Good placement! Fuller in length in line of the stumps, Mortaza clears his front leg and heaves it over long on to find the fence.
Perera brings out the bouncer this time, Mashrafe has enough time to duck under it.
Fuller in length, Mortaza puts his head down and defends it calmly.
On a length around off, angling in, kept out from the comfort of the crease.
Short of a length outside off, played with an open bat face towards backward point.
Starts off his new spell with a full ball speared in on middle, driven down the ground through mid on to rotate strike.
Thisara Perera is back on.
Aponso gives this one more air and lands it around off, pushed with soft hands towards covers.
Floated delivery around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slower through the air, kept out watchfully.
Similar ball, knocked down to long off for a run.
Full ball outside off, eased through covers for a single.
Full length ball, kept out watchfully.
Short ball, Mortaza ducks under it.
The Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza, comes out to bat.

OUT! Take a bow, Lakmal! That is a stunning catch. A partnership which was building up has been cut short. Full ball on off, Hasan drives it uppishly back towards the bowler. Suranga gets low on his followthrough and takes a brilliant catch to his left and then tumbles down. He plucked that out of thin air. Such moments in the field can change games.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Safe! On a length on middle, Rahim plays it towards cover-point and takes off. Mendis runs in with the ball in his hand and hits the stumps as Mehidy drags his bat in. The ball ricochets through square leg and he himself runs after it. The batsmen take another run. The square leg umpire refers it upstairs in order to be sure. Replay finds Hasan to be safe. This is Mushfiqur's highest ODI score against Sri Lanka, surpassing his previous best of 79.
Leg bye! Full ball, shaping in. Hasan tries to flick it away but the ball brushes his pads and rolls to the leg side. A single is stolen.
Two Wides! Slips a fullish delivery down the leg side, Mushfiqur fails to put bat to ball. Kusal Perera dives to his left but fails to stop it cleanly. Another extra run results.
Drifting down the leg side, helped away to fine leg for a run and Rahim will retain strike.
Flighted ball around off, Hasan places it towards cover-point to rotate strike.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slower through the air, Mehidy kneels and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket. There is a big gap in the deep and by the time the fielder cuts it off, the batsmen have taken three runs.
Quicker in pace, coming in with the arm. Hasan comes forward to dead-bat it.
Tossed up outside off, eased through covers for a single.
Slower ball from Lakmal outside off, played with an angled bat towards the point region.
Good judgement! Rahim taps the length ball towards covers and sets off. The fielder there attacks the ball but misses his shy at the bowler's end. Would have been safe even if he had hit.
Shortish ball and there is room on offer, Hasan goes for a flashy cut but gets it off the outer half towards third man. A single taken.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Fullish delivery, pushed down towards mid off.
BREAKING NEWS - Tamim Iqbal has been ruled out of the Asia Cup with a fractured wrist.

Full ball on middle, clipped through mid-wicket as the batsmen call for two runs. Malinga chases it from mid on and puts in a fake slide. Umpire Marais Erasmus walks across to him and has a word with him, warning him. The new rule is that such a thing can be penalized. For now, Malinga is safe.
Suranga Lakmal is back on.
Rahim comes down the track and pushes this one back to the bowler.

FOUR! Wickets are falling at the other end but Rahim is continuing to play his natural game. He is getting away with it at the moment. Loopy ball on off, Rahim kneels and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket to find the fence.
Rahim is nimble on his feet to this tossed up ball and nails the drive but picks out the extra cover fielder again.
Slower through the air, Mehidy reaches the pitch of the delivery and places it to long off for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle and off, driven nicely but finds the extra cover fielder.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a couple.
Short of a length ball around the hips, Hasan moves inside the line and tucks it to fine leg for a single.
Wide! Malinga loses his radar again and sprays this one down the leg side as Mehidy fails to put bat to ball.
There's the bouncer and it has been well-directed as well. Mehidy has got enough on the pull and gets it over mid-wicket. A couple taken.
Another full and fast delivery, on the boots this time. Mehidy clears his front leg and jams it out.
The plan is clear from Malinga. He is trying to sneak under Hasan's bat. Full and a fast ball on off, kept out towards mid on.
The slower ball from Malinga and it has been delivered with needle-like precision on middle stump. Mehidy clips it towards mid-wicket.
Full ball attacking the base of the off stump, driven down the ground towards mid on.
Wide! Malinga goes for the yorker but misses his mark. Slips it down the leg side, Hasan tries to clip it away but misses.
Tossed up generously around off, Rahim strides ahead and taps it gently to covers.
Mushfiqur goes hard on the drive to this loopy delivery and mistimes it back towards the bowler.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Similar delivery, Rahim drives it to the left of the bowler who dives but fails to stop it cleanly. A single results.
Slower through the air, knocked down to long off for a single.
Fullish delivery and it is tossed up as well, swept away through short fine leg for a single.
Time for Drinks! Meanwhile, Mehidy Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! Malinga is on fire! Picks up a 4-fer with utmost ease. This is turning out to be a dream return for the wily old fox in international cricket. He steams in and hits the deck hard. Gets the ball to get big on Hossain as well. He goes for the pull across the line but ends up gloving it behind. Kusal Perera takes a few steps forward and gets low to pouch it safely. Bangladesh have lost 3 wickets for only 8 runs. Sri Lanka are back on top.
Fullish delivery around off, kept out watchfully.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, Hossain drives it off the inner half towards mid on.
Full and down the leg side, tickled down to fine leg for a run.
Malinga opts for the short one around off, pulled towards short mid-wicket where the fielder moves to his right and puts in a good dive to keep the batsmen down to a single.
Full length ball on off, Mosaddek pushes it with soft hands towards mid on.
FOUR! Deft! Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Rahim gets across and sweeps it nicely past the short fine leg fielder to find the fence. A wicket and 4 from the over.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Stays right behind the line of the ball and blocks it with the full face of the bat.
Spinning away from around off, worked square to point. No run taken.
Mosaddek Hossain is the new man in to bat.

OUT! Oh, what a catch! On a day where the Lankans have been putting the catches down, Dhananjaya de Silva  has pulled off an absolute blinder. Tossed up and drifting in on middle, Mahmudullah clears his front leg and tries to play the slog sweep. Makes a complete mess of it and the ball takes a top edges. It balloons towards extra cover, where de Silva watches the ball closely, gets under it and dives behind to his right to takes a stunner. Just what the doctor ordered for Sri Lanka.
Full outside off, driven to the cover region.
He's off the mark now. Mahmudullah taps this down with an open face to third man and takes a single.
Short of a length delivery close to off, kept out off the back foot.
Strays it on the pads, Rahim flicks it away on the leg side for a single.
Mahmudullah walks out to the middle.

OUT! Malinga returns and gets the breakthrough. Mathews had to do something, he brought his strike bowler back into the attack and he's delivered. Fuller in length and it's the slower one, Mithun doesn't pick it up and looks to flick it over the leg side early. The ball takes the leading edge and it skies above, a little behind on the off side. Kusal Perera settles himself under it and holds on to it. Partnership of 131 comes to an end and Mithun walks back after a super knock.
Drives this full length delivery towards mid on. Dot ball.
Outside off on a good length, pushed to the point region.
Lasith Malinga is back for a burst.
Slower through the air, dealt with nicely off the front foot.
Nicely done! Short and outside off, cut away with the spin through point. The sweeper cover fielder moves to his left and keeps the batsmen down to a couple.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up around off, swept uppishly but in the gap. It goes on the bounce to the deep square leg fielder. A run taken.
Drifting in on middle stump, Mohammad goes back and just about manages to keep it out.

FOUR! This is one for the papers! Mithun holds the pose for the cameras to capture. Tossed up on middle, Mithun makes use of his feet again and lofts it straight back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
An unofficial drinks break has been taken. Can't blame them, it is scorching out there. The players are getting some fluids in. In this time, Amila Aponso is back into the bowling attack.
Full length delivery on off stump, blocked.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Worked it away on the leg side and a single is taken.

Not out! Full in line of the stumps, Mushfiqur drives it towards mid on. Thisara Perera there collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. It's taken upstairs and replays show that the batsman is fine. Rahim survives.
Taken upstairs again. Another direct hit but the Sri Lankan team doesn't look that interested Says a lot in itself. We'll see though.

FOUR! Innovative from Rahim. This is clever batting. Lovely stuff. Mushfiqur premeditates the full delivery and goes across his sticks. He scoops it over the keeper's head and finds the fence with ease.
Full ball attacking the stumps, tamely driven to mid off.
Flicked away through mid-wicket. No trouble to take the run.
In the air but wide. Fell short too. Mithun brings out the reverse sweep but isn't exactly in control. Off the top half and it falls beside short third man. Single collected.
Some drift on this occasion, Mithun drives it to short mid-wicket.
Too full, quite straight, it's flicked through the mid-wicket region. A single is taken as the fielder chases it down. Kusal Mendis is the man.
Outside off, punched through point for a double.
Dilruwan needs to slow it up. Bowling too quick which isn't allowing the ball to turn and the batsmen are dealing with him well. Mithun skips down and flicks it in front of square for one.
With an open face Mithun dabs this through point and takes a run.

Fifty for Mushfiqur Rahim, his 30th  in this format. He came in during a tricky situation for his side and has shored it to safe waters. He stays inside the crease and works it through the square leg area for a single. Needs to carry on now, a big one is what his teammates would be hoping is on the cards.
Leans across to this back of a length delivery and tucks it through backward square leg for a couple of easy runs.
Just ahead of a length, on the stumps, driven to long on for a single.
Shortish in length, on middle and leg, worked down to fine leg for one run.
Back of a length delivery on off stump, pushed away gently towards the man at cover.
Dasun Shanaka is brought on into the attack.
That one stayed low! A fraction shorter, Mithun goes for the cut but the ball skids through and goes under his bat.
Spinning in slowly from around off, helped towards the man at 45 to change strike.
A half-tracker outside off, cut away hard through square of the wicket on the off side for a single. Perera is lucky there as it could have been hit to the fence.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
A bit shorter outside off, placed through point to rotate strike.

Fullish ball drifting down the leg side, Rahim tucks it around the corner for a single. The 100-run stand is up between the two. They have staged a terrific comeback for their side. Bangladesh are in a strong position now.
Dilruwan Perera is back.
Short of a good length coming in on off, Rahim offers a firm punch through the covers for a run.
Lakmal brings out the bumper but Mushfiqur is up for it. Ducks and evades without any trouble.
Fraction straight in line, behind a length, defensively pushed on the leg side for a quick one.

Edged and FOUR! Streaky runs but Bangladesh will take it. Also, maiden ODI fifty for Mohammad Mithun. He was given an opportunity early in the innings and he's made full use of that. Length ball outside off, it goes off the outer half through the vacant slip cordon for a boundary.
Seaming in off the deck, a length delivery on middle and leg, Rahim moves inside the line and helps it down to fine leg for a single.
Not in complete control, but still manages to get it away to earn a run. Mithun drives it wide of the bowler on the leg side and jogs across to the other end.
Drives this quicker ball through to long on and changes ends.
Goes deep inside the crease to this shorter ball and helps it through mid-wicket for a single.
Turned away on the leg side. No run taken.
SIX! That's outta here! That's a good strike from Mushfiqur Rahim. He skips out of his crease, meets the ball at its pitch and then lifts it well over the man at long on to clear the rope.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Leans ahead to this fuller ball and drives it to long on. Single collected.
Mithun charges out looking to drive but gets an inside edge down to fine leg. Two runs to the total.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Safe! Well... wasn't as close as I thought. On leg, it goes off Rahim's pads towards square leg and both batsmen take off. The fielder there charges to the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Umpire Erasmus takes it upstairs and replays show Mushfiqur is fine.
A run out appeal is referred. It's a direct hit and it looks tight. Mushfiqur Rahim is in the limelight. Let's see now...
A little update on Tamim Iqbal - he has been taken to the hospital for scans and an official word on his condition should be out around the innings break.
Full in length, driven to mid off.
Cutting back in on middle and leg from a length, goes off the thigh pad and falls on the leg side as the batsmen take a leg bye.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. One run added to the total.
Suranga Lakmal is back on to bowl.
9 off the over. This is smart cricket from the Tigers. Mushfiqur nudges this through the vacant mid-wicket area and keeps strike.
Off the pads this time, but another run. Mithun misses his flick shot and it goes off the pads towards square leg. A leg bye results.
Another brisk run. Good running. Rahim taps it square on the off side and calls for it. His partner responds and both batsmen complete the run with ease.
Mithun uses the depth of the crease before turning it away with the spin in front of square leg for a single.
Plays this square through point and gets to the other end.

A lot of flight on this from around the wicket, drifting away, Rahim drives this through the covers. Dilruwan out in the deep, moves to his right, tumbles to stop it but the effort is so lazy that the ball goes under his fingertips. Concedes an unnecessary boundary.
Dhananjaya de Silva is on.
Full and shaping back in, the drive is mistimed off the inner half towards mid on.

That's a good stop from Dhananjaya de Silva. Back of a length with room offered outside off, Rahim cuts it square towards point. He's hit it well too, but de Silva there dives low to his right and gets a hand on it. Saves valuable runs, keeps the batsmen down to one.
Too straight in line, easy enough for the batsman to work it away into the gap on the leg side. One run to the total.
Just behind a length, outside the line of off stump, Mithun opens the face and taps it down in front of backward point.
Good length delivery attacking the off stump, it's tapped down in front of covers.
Seaming back in on leg, Rahim picks it off his pads and works it in front of square leg for a quick one.

FOUR! On fire here! 14 runs off the over. Dilruwan comes from around the wicket and darts it full and across, Mithun is forward and drives it sweetly through the covers to find the fence, beating the man in the deep.
FOUR! This is good batting. Poor bowling though. Dilruwan bowls it short, flat and wide outside off, gives Mithun room as he rocks back and cuts it wide of short third man for a boundary.
SIX! Takes the attack to the offie and gets the desired result. Makes great use of his feet, gets close to the pitch and Mithun smokes it high and handsome over long off for a maximum.
Outside off, full in length, blocked neatly off the middle.
Too full and no turn again, quicker through the air once more, Mithun looks to reverse paddle but wears a blow on the front pad. Impact is outside the line of off stump though.
Quicker and straighter outside off, cut down to short third man for no run.

Time for Drinks! After a horrid start, Bangladesh are somewhat in a calmer situation. The 50-run unbroken partnership being the reason behind it. Mushfiqur Rahim and Mohammad Mithun have had lucky moments but the good thing for the Bangla Tigers is that they are still out there. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, need to have more intensity on the field. A wicket or two might well put them back on top. Meanwhile, Dilruwan Perera to roll his arm over now. He is coming back into the ODI side after a long time and will be eager to make an impression.

Good running! Short and room on offer, Rahim cuts it towards deep backward point. The fielder from third man moves to his right to cut it off. The batsmen run hard and complete the second run. The 50-run stand is up between the duo, good going this.

Not in control but safe! Back of a length well outside off, Mithun goes for the cut shot but his bottom hand comes off the handle. The ball goes through the vacant backward point region. A single taken.
Good length delivery, angling in. Mithun has no space to work with as he defends it off the back foot towards covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length ball well outside off, Mithun cuts it nicely towards point.
On a length around off, Mohammad taps it towards the man at point and wants a run but is rightly sent back by his partner.
Wide! Shortish delivery down the leg side, Mithun lets it go. 50 comes up for Bangladesh.
Shorter in length, turned with the angle through square leg for a run. 9 from this over.

FOUR! Cheeky and mighty effective! Loopy ball around off, Mithun brings out the fancy reverse sweep and executes it to perfection through short fine leg. Mathews has a tough chase to make and only comes second best.
Full delivery outside off, hit down through mid off to rotate strike.

Rahim pre-meditates by shuffling across to the loopy ball as Aponso bowls it fullish on off. Mushfiqur makes good connection as he sweeps it all along the carpet through backward square leg. A couple taken.
Tossed up generously around off, Rahim prods forward in defense.
Slower through the air, knocked down to long off for a single.
Fractionally overpitched in line of the stumps, whipped through mid-wicket for an easy run.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
A bouncer on off, pulled away with control to deep square leg for a single.
Rush of blood from Rahim! No need to attempt such audacious shots. Short and wide outside off, Rahim reaches for it with an upper cut but misses.
Shortish ball which sits up nicely for Mithun who pulls it to fine leg to rotate strike.
Full and straying on the pads, tucked around the corner for an easy single.

SIX! Boom! Tossed up ball around off, Mithun dances down the track and tonks it towards long off. The fielder stationed near the ropes is interested for a while but eventually watches it sail over his head into the stands. 12 from the over.
Stump-to-stump line from Aponso, pushed back down the track.
Rahim drives this one with the spin through extra cover for a single.
FOUR! Great execution! Slower through the air around off, Rahim crouches and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary. That will make him feel good.
Loopy delivery, defended nicely off the front foot.
Tossed up ball, eased through covers for a run.
Time for Powerplay 2! Maximum of four fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
On middle and leg, helped towards square leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Around off and full, placed through mid off for a single.
Full ball again, clipped through square leg for a single.

DROPPED! There is no excuse for putting down such catches and Dilruwan Perera has nowhere to hide. Full ball on middle and leg, Rahim falls over a bit and is not able to control his flick shot. Perera who is stationed in front of square leg comes forward a touch and makes a mess of it, eventually spilling it. Sri Lanka can't afford to waste such a good start. How costly will this prove?
Full length ball on middle and off, Rahim covers the line and blocks it.
Double change. Thisara Perera is introduced for a bowl.
On a flatter trajectory, coming in with the natural angle. Mithun is hurried a touch as he defends it down the track.
Slower through the air and a lot of loop on this one, Rahim milks it down to long off for a single.
Comes forward nicely to the loopy ball and eases it with the spin to the covers.
Slower through the air, Mushfiqur comes forward and presents a water-tight defense.
Mithun comes down the track and drives this one down to long on for a single.
Starts off with a really good delivery! Bowls the arm ball and it keeps on coming in. Mithun prods forward to block it but gets it off the inner half towards short fine leg.
Amila Aponso comes into the attack. Spin for the first time in Powerplay 1.

FOUR! Nicely controlled! Full ball attacking the stumps, Rahim clips it nicely past the short mid-wicket fielder and the ball races to the fence. That is the first boundary of the innings, took 48 balls to come.
On a length well outside off, played with an angled bat towards point.
Full length ball around off, Rahim comes forward and defends it right under his eyes.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
On a length, angling in, answered with a straight bat from the comfort of the crease.
Length ball outside off, dabbed towards point to rotate strike.
On a length around off, Mohammad walks down the track and taps it towards mid on for a quick run.

A very full ball on middle, Mithun clips it nicely through wide mid on. Mathews goes after it from the same region and keeps the batsmen down to a couple. Mithun thought about the third run but Rahim sent him back.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Ooh... that one swung in appreciably. Fullish ball, shaping in sharply. Mithun jams it out towards mid-wicket. Would have been a candidate for an LBW had he missed it.
Good length ball outside off, Mohammad plays it with an open bat face towards point.
Fullish ball on middle, swinging away a little. Mithun pushes it with soft hands towards covers.
Full length ball in line of the stumps, Mushfiqur puts his head down and defends it calmly. Another tight over, only 2 from it.
Just outside off and on a length, Rahim makes a good leave.
Short of a length ball, pulled away to fine leg for a single.
A slower one by Lakmal and Rahim gets deceived by it. He gets it off the inner half towards square leg for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
In the zone outside off, Rahim leaves it alone.

Taken this time but it doesn't matter! Sharp short ball on off, takes off. Rahim goes for a pull but gets a top edge towards mid on. Mathews there accepts it but it won't reflect in the wickets column. A run is taken.

Dropped, but a No Ball! A lot of drama is happening at the moment. That was a marginal call for a waist height no ball, could have gone either way but anyways, the catch was not taken. Malinga bowls another high full toss on leg stump but it is dipping. Mithun is surprised a touch and ends up pulling it uppishly towards fine leg. The fielder there runs in, gets his hands to it but the ball pops out, brushes his chest and falls down. To add insult to injury, a Free Hit is coming up...
Wide! An attempted yorker ends up being a full toss down the leg side. Mithun tries to play it away but has no conviction in doing so and misses.
Good length ball outside off, played with an open bat face towards the point region.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

DROPPED! It was a brilliant attempt though. Would have been a gem of a catch had Mathews taken it. Fuller in length on middle and leg, stops a bit on the track perhaps. Mithun closes his bat face early and eventually gets a soft leading edge towards mid on. Angelo charges in and puts in a full length dive, reaches the ball as well. He gets both his hands to it but it doesn't stick. Malinga has his hands on his head.
In the channel outside off, Mohammad doesn't fiddle with it.
On a length outside off, Mithun shuffles a touch and taps it with soft hands square of the wicket on the off side.
Nicely played! Back of a length and some width on offer. Rahim punches it off his back foot through cover-point. The fielder from point chases it and keeps the batsmen to a couple.

That was a loose shot from Rahim! Needs to be careful with his side already two down. On a good length outside off, Rahim tries to drive away from the body but mistimes it besides the pitch on the off side.
Nicely bowled! Fuller in length, swinging in nicely. Rahim clips it off the inner half towards mid on.
Not close enough to make the batsman play and Mushfiqur lets it go.
Good length ball on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Short of a length ball well outside off, Mithun plays it with an angled bat through the backward point region for a single.
On a length on the fifth stump channel, not fiddled with. Malinga is on song, a maiden for him.
A bit fuller in length and pacy as well. Rahim covers the line of the delivery and dead-bats it.
Back of a length delivery and it is moving away after landing. Rahim doesn't fiddle with it.
A better-directed bouncer as it is attacking Mushfiqur. He ducks under it in a jiffy to evade it.
A surprise bouncer from Malinga but the line could have been better. It is outside off and Rahim does nicely to sway away from the line of the ball.
A brilliant ball but he doesn't get his fourth hat-trick. Fullish ball on middle, swinging away sharply, opening Rahim up. He somehow keeps it away off the outer half of the bat.

Lasith Malinga already has three hat-tricks in ODI cricket. No.4 on the way right now? Bad news for Bangladesh - Tamim Iqbal is going off the field. This isn't a good sign at all, especially with two wickets already down. Mohammad Mithun walks out to the middle. Mushfiqur Rahim will face the hat-trick ball. Two slips and a leg gully in place...

Ouch! That will sting. Short ball attacking the body of the batsman, Tamim goes for the pull but is late on it. Ends up getting hit on the gloves as the ball rolls towards short mid-wicket. Seems like he has done some damage to his wrist.
Back of a length on the fifth stump channel, Rahim dabs it past the point fielder for a run and gets off the mark.
Outside off, third leave in a row by Mushfiqur.
A bit wider outside off, shaping away nicely. Rahim points his bat skywards to let it be.
On a length outside off, shaping away. Rahim shoulders his arms to it.
Good length ball around off, Iqbal places it behind backward point and takes a single.
Suranga Lakmal to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. Meanwhile, Mushfiqur Rahim strides out to bat with his team in early trouble.

OUT! Bowled 'em! The best exponent of bamboozling the batsmen is in the thick of things. Bangladesh have been rocked early and Shakib walks back dejected for a golden duck. Malinga steams in and bowls a full and fast delivery on off. It does a lot in the air as the ball swings back in appreciably. Shakib is late to bring his bat down as he tries to jam it across the line but misses it altogether to get his stumps shattered. The perfect start for Malinga and Sri Lanka this. He will be on a hat-trick in his next over.
Shakib Al Hasan comes out to bat.

OUT! Malinga is off and running, what a start for him after a layoff of around 16 months. His team knows the importance of him performing this way and they barge towards him with big smiles on their faces. Coming back to the ball, it is in the avenue of apprehension and after landing, the ball seams away substantially. Das is opened up in his stance and pokes at it. Ends up getting a thick outside edge behind. Kusal Mendis at first slip gets low to his left and takes a fine catch before tumbling down. Das' comeback in the ODI side has been a fruitless one.
Malinga attacks the stumps with a full length ball and there is some nibble in the air. Das covers the line and stonewalls it.
Good flow of the bat from Liton! Back of a length and there is some room on offer, Das frees his arms and cuts it straight to the man at point.

Well bowled! A little bit of shape there. In the corridor of uncertainty around off and the ball swings away appreciably. Das thinks of fishing at it initially but then decides to bail out in the nick of time.
Bangladesh and Tamim are away! Malinga starts off with a fullish ball but the line is awry. It is down the leg side and Iqbal clips it nicely towards fine leg for a single.

The players are out for their respective national anthems. After the completion, we are set to get rolling. It is really hot out in the middle and it will be interesting to see how both the sides adapt to the conditions. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das to open the batting for Bangladesh. Lasith Malinga to steam in with the first new ball. He is making a comeback after a long time and there might be some nerves on display but we all know what a champion he is. A sole slip in place. Here we go...

Sri Lanka skipper, Angelo Mathews, says that they would have liked to bat first as well. Mentions that it might slow down later and there can be some dew but they can't control these things. States that it is really good to have Lasith Malinga back. Adds that he can hand the ball to him at crunch moments and tough circumstances. Wants his players to assess the wicket well. Ends by saying that the heat is terrible but they can't think of these things.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza, says that they will bat first. Mentions that it looks like a good wicket. Expects his bowlers to get some purchase later on. States that it is better to bat first, put up a good total and back his spinners to come to the party with the wicket expected to slow down a touch. Ends by saying that Tamim Iqbal and his bowlers did well in the West Indies and hopes they will continue to do so.
TOSS - Bangladesh win the toss and opt to bat.

PITCH REPORT - Ramiz Raja says that the surface looks like a beauty. Mentions that there is no grass on the track and there will be hardly anything for the spinners too. States that it is a belter and the batsmen will enjoy themselves. Adds that there are a few cracks but they won't cause any trouble. Ends by saying that the dew can come into play in the later half of the game but informs that the groundsman feels that it won't be much of a concern.

Sri Lanka, on the other hand, have a good blend of youth and experience. Lasith Malinga coming back into the squad will boost their confidence by leaps and bounds. Their captain, Angelo Mathews, is in rich vein of form with the bat and will be aiming to lead from the front. Expect a cracker!

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the opening encounter of the Asia Cup between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka in Dubai. Six teams will be vying for the coveted trophy and we are in for some edge-of-the-seat contests. The Bangla Tigers have some explosive players in their ranks and will be eager to start off their campaign on a bright note. They haven't won the Asia Cup ever and it is enough motivation for them to go all out.
